test_title: SSC CGL Tier 2 English Previous Paper 1 (Held on: 8 Aug 2022)
subject: english
question:
**Given below are four jumbled sentences. Select the option that gives their correct order forming a meaningful and coherent paragraph.**

A. In 1943, sudden retrenchment from his office due to the war cost him his nine-year-old job.

B. In 1934, Patol Babu gave up his factory job and came to Calcutta with his wife.

C. Ever since, Patol Babu had struggled to make a living.

D. The sailing was smooth for some years and Patol Babu was in his boss's good books.
solution:
The correct answer is **'BDAC'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• Statement B will come first as it contains the subject i.e. 'Patol babu' and it represents the earliest part of the timeline i.e. 1934.
 
• Statement D will follow statement B as it mentions the events that happened for a few years when Patol babu arrived at Calcutta.
 
• Statement A will follow statement D as it mentions the sudden events because of which he lost his job.
 
• Statement C will come last.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is option 4.

The final sequence will be: 

 
• B: In 1934, Patol Babu gave up his factory job and came to Calcutta with his wife.
 
• D: The sailing was smooth for some years and Patol Babu was in his boss's good books.
 
• A: In 1943, sudden retrenchment from his office due to the war cost him his nine-year-old job.
 
• C: Ever since, Patol Babu had struggled to make a living.
